source.title: Automations: set a custom schedule and timezone, and check when it really runs

labels.name: feedback
labels.description: Try the hosted app and tell us what you find

source.body:
Check custom cron schedules and timezones on automations.

## Try this

1. In Automations, choose New automation with a custom Cron expression, `*/15 * * * *` (every 15 minutes), and a small job: `Add the current time to a file called ticks.md, one line per run.`
2. Set Timezone to your own, for example Europe/London or Asia/Kolkata. Save and turn it on.
3. Make a second one with `0 9 * * 1-5` and a timezone far from yours.
4. Watch the first runs of each.
5. Try saving an invalid cron and an invalid timezone.
6. Pause or delete the 15 minute one when you're done.

## What to look for

- Runs happen when you expected for that timezone, give or take a minute.
- The history shows the same times.
- Invalid values get a clear message instead of a save that silently fails.
- Pausing stops new runs.

## Your report

Post one comment here with:

- Links to your threads (`app.useagent.org/session/...`)
- What worked
- What broke or confused you, and what you expected instead
- Screenshots or a short screen recording
- Your timezone, the schedules you used, and when they ran

Open a separate bug issue for anything broken, with the steps to reproduce it, and link it in your comment.

No need to claim; post your report as a comment.

---

**General asks**
- Do the steps yourself in the hosted app. Sign up with your email at [app.useagent.org](https://app.useagent.org/login?ref=feedback); you don't need an API key or a card to start. The link in the sign-up email works for 24 hours, so check spam if it's missing.
- Run everything by hand. Reports from runs done or simulated by another AI tool get closed.
- Use made-up details, test accounts and data you own. Don't point the agent at other people's accounts, inboxes or private data, and don't send real forms or messages to strangers.
- More than one person can report on the same issue, and every report helps. If someone already found what you found, add only what's different.
- Stuck? Comment here with a screenshot and we'll help.

**Keep private details out of here**

This page is public. Don't post your real email, phone number, address, API keys, or screenshots that show any of them; blur them first. Send anything private to **hi@useagent.org** with a link to your comment here.

**Using AI tools, and what gets no reply**
- AI help is fine. Blind AI output is not. You must understand every line you submit, run it yourself, and show it working in the app with your own screenshots or recording.
- Pull requests that look generated and untested get closed without a reply and labeled `spam`, which also means they don't count for Hacktoberfest. Signs we look for: no proof from a real run, code that ignores this repo's patterns or reinvents helpers that already exist, unrelated files changed, a description that only restates the issue, and failing checks nobody looked at.
- One pull request per issue, by the person who claimed it. Opening pull requests on issues someone else has taken, or several near-identical pull requests for the same bounty, counts as farming and gets the same treatment.
- Bounties are paid only for the verified outcome the issue describes (for example, a workshop that actually happened, or an app that works on both systems), never for a write-up, a plan, or an unfinished attempt.
- When we ask a question in review, answer it in your own words. If you can't explain your change, we can't merge it.
